summary: Remote-command daemon connects to hardcoded WSS gateway with PTY execution surface
details: @whalent/agent runs as a long-lived daemon that connects to a hardcoded WebSocket gateway at wss://memory.whalent.com/gw/sdk/ws (overridable via --gateway) and, per the package's own README, accepts remote commands including 'upgrade' and 'restart' from that gateway. The package bundles node-pty and @xterm/headless, giving it a full pseudo-terminal execution surface on the installer's host. The main runtime bundle dist/core.cjs (~4.8MB) is processed with javascript-obfuscator (string-array rotator, hex identifier renaming, control-flow flattening; javascript-obfuscator ^5.3.0 is declared in devDependencies and invoked from build.mjs), so the exact set of message types the gateway can dispatch to the PTY/exec runtime is not auditable from the shipped source. dist/index.cjs additionally imports child_process. Once the daemon is running under an installer's token, whoever controls memory.whalent.com has an interactive command channel on the host that installed the agent, and the obfuscated dispatcher prevents the installer from verifying which commands are and are not remotely reachable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
